items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: of course I was inspired by the master, Sidney Bechet. And I was his understudy once in a play.

ctx.x: never seem to get a bunch of them that could play these cats in tune together. So like they sort of went out of style because they sound kind of bad when you put three or four of them together. Then I didn't take it up again until -- but I always had one, and I started to fool around with it, and my wife heard it, and she says, gee, that sounds beautiful. Why don't you play that instrument? I believe that you could do something with that instrument.

So I said, well, I think I will give it a try; instead of continuing with the clarinet, I think I'll just pick up soprano, and of course I was inspired by the master, Sidney Bechet. And I was his understudy once in a play.
